values.note: First-come only: claim a site in person; on site you may be able to pay through the Recreation.gov app's Scan and Pay (download it first, little cell service).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/lower-hermosa-campground ('19 sites available, all first come, first serve') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250659 ('available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site'; Scan and Pay), read 2026-10-28

note: Columbine RD (San Juan NF) campground ~18 mi N of Durango: US-550 to Hermosa, then CR 201 / Forest Rd 576 about 4 mi; beside the Lower Hermosa Creek Trailhead (horse corral there; horses not allowed in the campground). Sits above Hermosa Creek with no creek access from sites. Narrow dirt access road, passable for a 23-ft rig. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov: confirmed max RV 30 ft, vault toilets, no water, FCFS only, $18 (2026); added site count 19 and a season note (May-September). Note trimmed of field facts and corrected (a vault toilet is in the campground too).
flags: Missing phone: Columbine Ranger District (970) 884-2512 (FS page office block, Bayfield; open Fridays only). recreation.gov lists the concessionaire's contact (661) 702-1420 (goexplorus.com email).

Road: FR 576 (Lower Hermosa) open 5/1-12/31 with no special conditions on the San Juan NF Columbine road table 'As of October 26, 2026', after the October 22-25 flooding. The Hermosa Park Road (FR 578) closure Sept 8-Oct 13, 2026 starts just beyond the trailhead and does not affect the campground.
Status: FS banner 'Site Closed' is the end of season (fee season ended Sep 19). No closure order found.

Criteria: the FS page lists 'Horse Camping' under recreation, but horses are kept to the adjacent trailhead corral; the campground itself is a general drive-in campground (horses not allowed). Not a horse camp.
Waterfront: stored not waterfront confirmed. Hermosa Creek is not visible within ~350 m of the pin on imagery; the loops sit in ponderosa on the bench above.
Pin 37.45548,-107.85820 is the recreation.gov facility/Scan-and-Pay point and ~50 m from the FS coordinate (37.455613,-107.857679). OK.
